# BFA

> The convenience store for AI agents. Open 24 hours, for every agent. BFA is an open pay-per-call API market for AI agents. Agents discover, quote and pay for one API call at a time over x402 V2 (USDC on Base), signed by their NEAR account via Chain Signatures. There is no EVM private key in config. Listings are open to anyone through a PR, and they route only after peer review pinned to the manifest's sha256. Owners give each agent an API key with an expiry, a daily cap, per-API caps, an allow/block list and routing: an ordered list of preferred listings or providers that is tried first when the agent asks by query, with an optional strict switch that forbids fallback to other providers. Status: works on testnet (NEAR testnet + Base Sepolia). Not on mainnet yet.

Quick verification without accounts: `pnpm install && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm registry:check`. The README lists live testnet transactions and labels which parts are real and which are not done yet.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what it does, offline test steps, the live testnet run with tx hashes, MCP config, per-key routing, the listing flow, what is real and what is not
- [Listing schema](registry/schema/listing.schema.json): the bfa.json manifest a seller submits
- [Review schema](registry/schema/review.schema.json): the review record that makes a listing routable

## Code

- [MCP tools](packages/mcp-server/src/tools.ts): discover, inspect, quote, run, receipts, wallet, submit_listing
- [Paying client](packages/x402-client/src/pay.ts): x402 V2 payment, price ceiling, receipts, batch-settlement session
- [Chain Signatures signer](packages/x402-client/src/near-mpc.ts): derives the Base address and signs through the MPC contract v1.signer-prod.testnet / v1.signer
- [Registry and routing](packages/core/src/registry.ts): validation and review gating; [router](packages/core/src/router.ts) handles ranking and per-key routing (`routeRank`)
- [API keys](packages/gateway/src/keys.ts) and [key policy](packages/gateway/src/policy.ts): expiry, caps, allow/block lists and routing, enforced by the hosted gateway
- [Listing bot](packages/x402-client/src/bot.ts): unpaid probe of a seller's 402 challenge
- [Demo seller](packages/demo-seller/src/server.ts): x402 seller for a NEAR-native endpoint

## Optional

- [Competitor UX research](docs/research/competitor-ux.md)
- [MCP smoke test](packages/mcp-server/scripts/smoke.mjs): runs every tool against the live testnet
